Our Deals/Oslo

Where to eat in Oslo on a budget

Eating out in Oslo can be expensive, but you don't have to skip the good places to keep your food budget in check. BIMM is a subscription app that unlocks real deals — 2-for-1 meals, fixed-amount NOK discounts, free items, gift cards and stamp-card loyalty rewards — at 71 restaurants and cafés, 48 of them running offers right now. There are no coupons or codes to fumble with: you book a deal in the app, show up and swipe to check in, whether you live here or you're just visiting.
